scholarships.name: Explore Scholarships and Bursaries
scholarships.description: Explore a variety of scholarships and bursaries designed to reward academic excellence, leadership, and financial need. Explore Opportunities

scholarships.name: A grant
scholarships.description: : money you usually don't have to pay back

scholarships.name: Dr. Leonard Reeves Entrance Award for Women in Skilled Trades
scholarships.description: The Dr. Leonard Reeves Entrance Award for Women in Skilled Trades is available to students who self-identify as a woman, enrolling in eligible skilled trade programs. Learn more about applying

scholarships.name: Schulich Builders Scholarship
scholarships.description: Schulich Builders Scholarships are awarded to students enrolling in full-time certificate and diploma programs within eligible skilled trade fields at participating Ontario colleges. Learn more about applying

scholarships.name: Indigenous Leadership & Community Impact Award
scholarships.description: The Indigenous Leadership & Community Impact Award aims to enhance the abilities and confidence of Indigenous students as current and future leaders, innovators, and community builders. The award provides $3,000 in four payments throughout the academic year. Learn more about applying

scholarships.name: Application-Based Scholarships
scholarships.description: These awards require you to log on to Fanshawe’s Awards system and complete an application. Award applications are usually open near the start of each term, and remain open for three weeks. Refer to the dates to remember page for exact dates.

scholarships.name: Awards and Selection-based Scholarships
scholarships.description: These awards do not require an application for consideration. They have been designed with criteria that allow faculty and staff to identify a qualified student without needing students to apply. Note: Some selection-based awards require you to complete the general application form on Fanshawe’s Awa
